goal: Add an exclusive 'final' toggle and a free-text label/note per run to the Calibration and Weighting history modals, backed by a new mock-server PATCH contract, so users can mark which run was actually used for a (process, country, period) without guessing by date/tag.
scope_note: Cross-repo ticket (real ms-process-api is out of scope for this session per AGENTS.md convention). This session implements UI + mock-server contract only. A separate backend sub-issue (API) will implement the real PATCH endpoint later, validated against this same contract.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: mock-server exposes PATCH /events/:jobId for calibration runs accepting {is_final?, label?}; setting is_final=true on one job unsets is_final on every other job sharing the same country+period+stage='calibracion'
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: npm run mock:fast in background; curl -X PATCH localhost:8000/api/v1/events/<jobA> -d '{"is_final":true}' then curl -X PATCH localhost:8000/api/v1/events/<jobB same country/period> -d '{"is_final":true}'; GET /events and assert only jobB has is_final:true. Also new mock-server/__tests__ test file covers this + label persistence + 404 on unknown id.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: mock-server exposes PATCH /weighting/runs/:runId accepting {is_final?, label?} with the same exclusivity semantics scoped to country+period, mirroring the eligibility PATCH precedent
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: new mock-server/__tests__ test file: PATCH sets label freely; PATCH is_final=true on run A then run B (same country/period) unsets A; PATCH on unrelated country/period does not affect exclusivity; 404 on unknown runId

acceptance_criteria.criterion: EventSummary and WeightingRun TypeScript types include is_final?: boolean and label?: string | null; src/lib/api.ts exposes patchEvent(jobId, patch) and patchWeightingRun(runId, patch) calling the new PATCH routes
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: npx tsc -b passes; grep confirms both functions exist and are used by the modals (ac4/ac5)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: CalibrationHistoryModal renders a 'Final' star toggle and an editable label per row; clicking the star on a row marks it final and visually un-marks any other row for the same country+period after refetch; editing the label persists via patchEvent
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: new/updated vitest test in src/__tests__ mounts CalibrationHistoryModal with 2+ mocked events sharing country+period, clicks star on row 2, asserts patchEvent called with is_final:true and (after refetch mock) row 1's star is no longer active; types a label and asserts patchEvent called with the label on blur/submit

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WeightingHistoryModal has the equivalent 'Final' star toggle + editable label per row, same exclusivity behavior on the UI side
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: new/updated vitest test in src/__tests__ mirroring ac4 for WeightingHistoryModal + patchWeightingRun

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Full verify gate green and a live Playwright walkthrough of at least one modal (calibration or weighting) confirms the star toggle and label are visible and clickable in the running app
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: npm test && npm run lint && npx tsc -b && npm run build all exit 0; evaluator drives the running app (mock:fast + dev:e2e) with Playwright MCP: open a country's history modal, click the final star on a run, confirm badge appears, type+save a label, confirm it persists after modal close/reopen

tasks.desc: mock-server: add PATCH /events/:jobId in sync.js (or wherever the jobs Map lives) with is_final exclusivity (scope: country+period+stage) and label passthrough; add mock-server/__tests__ coverage

mock-server: add RunStore.update(runId, patch) (mirror EligibilityStore.update) + PATCH /weighting/runs/:runId in weighting.js with is_final exclusivity (scope: country+period) and label passthrough; add mock-server/__tests__ coverage
frontend contract: add is_final?/label? to EventSummary (src/types/api.ts) and WeightingRun (src/modules/pesaje/types.ts); add patchEvent + patchWeightingRun to src/lib/api.ts
CalibrationHistoryModal: add Final star toggle + editable label column/cell, wire to patchEvent + refetch (react-query invalidate), widen GRID template
WeightingHistoryModal: same as t4 using patchWeightingRun
vitest: cover ac4/ac5 exclusivity + label persistence in both modal test files

Capture the real-backend gap as a new Linear sub-issue (API): PATCH /events/:jobId and /weighting/runs/:runId equivalents in ms-process-api, blocked-by nothing, related-to JAA-755. Link it in progress.md and Linear comment.
